svg.text: One Friday and two Sunday trips added · 4 / 6 September 2026 · all lake trips now covered
Two direct paths · original source vertices
Circles: original GTFS stops. Squares: mapped dock nodes. Pink: disclosed outside-water intervals.
Every outside interval lies in an actual endpoint dock zone. Inferred paths; no sailing-lane certification.
